---
title: "arXiv papers"
description: "Recent arXiv preprints on topics related to this project, refreshed daily."
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: settings
# Edit these to change what the daily build fetches.
topics <- c("firearm mortality", "waterborne outbreak", "NHANES")
per_topic <- 15
```

```{r}
#| label: fetch
library(httr2)
library(xml2)

ns <- c(a = "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom", arxiv = "http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom")
squish <- function(x) trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x))

fetch_arxiv <- function(term, n) {
  resp <- request("https://export.arxiv.org/api/query") |>
    req_url_query(search_query = paste0("all:", strsplit(term, "\\s+")[[1]], collapse = " AND "),
                  sortBy = "submittedDate", sortOrder = "descending",
                  max_results = n) |>
    req_user_agent("etlee110.github.io (https://github.com/etlee110/etlee110.github.io)") |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 4,
              is_transient = \(r) resp_status(r) %in% c(429, 500, 503),
              backoff = \(i) 15 * i) |>
    req_perform()
  entries <- xml_find_all(read_xml(resp_body_string(resp)), "//a:entry", ns)
  if (!length(entries)) return(NULL)
  one <- function(e, path) squish(xml_text(xml_find_first(e, path, ns)))
  data.frame(
    topic     = term,
    title     = one(entries, "a:title"),
    authors   = vapply(entries, \(e) paste(xml_text(xml_find_all(e, "a:author/a:name", ns)),
                                           collapse = ", "), ""),
    date      = substr(one(entries, "a:published"), 1, 10),
    category  = xml_attr(xml_find_first(entries, "arxiv:primary_category", ns), "term"),
    url       = one(entries, "a:id"),
    abstract  = one(entries, "a:summary")
  )
}

papers <- list()
for (t in topics) {
  papers[[t]] <- tryCatch(fetch_arxiv(t, per_topic), error = function(e) NULL)
  Sys.sleep(3)  # arXiv asks for at most one request every 3 seconds
}
papers <- do.call(rbind, papers)
if (!is.null(papers)) {
  papers <- papers[!duplicated(papers$url), ]
  papers <- papers[order(papers$date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render
#| output: asis
esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape
cat(sprintf("<p class='text-muted'>Last updated %s UTC &middot; %d papers across %d topics.</p>\n",
            format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"),
            if (is.null(papers)) 0L else nrow(papers), length(topics)))

cat('<form id="arxiv-form" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2" role="search">
  <input id="arxiv-q" class="form-control flex-grow-1" style="min-width:14rem" type="search"
         placeholder="Filter the list, or press Enter to search all of arXiv" aria-label="Search">
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Search arXiv</button>
</form>
<div id="arxiv-topics" class="mb-3">')
cat(sprintf('<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary me-1 mb-1" data-topic="%s">%s</button>',
            esc(topics), esc(topics)), sep = "\n")
cat('</div>
<p id="arxiv-status" class="small text-muted"></p>
<div class="table-responsive"><table class="table" id="arxiv-table">
<thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Paper</th><th>Topic</th></tr></thead><tbody>\n')

if (is.null(papers)) {
  cat('<tr><td colspan="3">Could not reach arXiv during this build; it will retry on the next daily run.</td></tr>\n')
} else {
  rows <- sprintf(
    '<tr data-text="%s"><td class="text-nowrap">%s</td><td><a href="%s"><strong>%s</strong></a><br><small>%s &middot; <code>%s</code></small><details><summary class="small">Abstract</summary><small>%s</small></details></td><td><small>%s</small></td></tr>',
    esc(tolower(paste(papers$title, papers$authors, papers$abstract, papers$topic))),
    papers$date, esc(papers$url), esc(papers$title), esc(papers$authors),
    esc(papers$category), esc(papers$abstract), esc(papers$topic))
  cat(rows, sep = "\n")
}
cat('</tbody></table></div>\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const form = document.getElementById("arxiv-form");
  const input = document.getElementById("arxiv-q");
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#arxiv-table tbody");
  const status = document.getElementById("arxiv-status");

  // typing filters the daily list
  function filter() {
    const q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let shown = 0;
    tbody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-text]").forEach(tr => {
      const hit = !q || q.split(/\s+/).every(w => tr.dataset.text.includes(w));
      tr.style.display = hit ? "" : "none";
      shown += hit;
    });
    status.textContent = q ? `${shown} matching papers in today's list. Press Enter to search all of arXiv in a new tab.` : "";
  }
  input.addEventListener("input", filter);

  document.querySelectorAll("#arxiv-topics [data-topic]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", () => { input.value = b.dataset.topic; filter(); }));

  // Enter / button: arXiv blocks in-page API calls (no CORS), so open its search page
  form.addEventListener("submit", ev => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    const q = input.value.trim();
    if (!q) return filter();
    window.open("https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=all&order=-announced_date_first&query=" +
                encodeURIComponent(q), "_blank", "noopener");
  });
})();
</script>
```
